findings.evidence: Produces a basic K8s + nvidia-device-plugin design: pods request `nvidia.com/gpu: 1`, default-scheduler bin-packs across nodes, autoscaler adds nodes when pending pods accumulate ... gang scheduling ... topology awareness (NVLink within node, InfiniBand / RoCE across)
